definition.source_feed_u_gap_count: FullBookRuntime.gap_count / CapturePlan.u_gap_count via apply_delta DeltaOutcome.GAP or U_RESET (excludes on_reconnect clears)
definition.persisted_capture_u_gap_count: ActiveEventWriter._note_continuity: consecutive persisted Bybit delta u with ui>last_u+1; markers excluded
definition.database_replay_u_gap_count: Replay of CH packet stream with same marker exclusion and u+1 rule

stale_dup_handling: u<=last ignored for gap counting in writer (only forward gaps); book apply ignores stale/dup

epochs.note: Live book resynced via REST in memory, but FR event has no new snapshot seed; offline replay cannot start a new exact epoch from capture alone
